28:t_015:8.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「Thanks for treating us, $$マオ$$!」

28:t_015:9.en:
$$甲児$$
「$$カミーユ$$, $$バナージ$$, you guys come too!」

28:t_015:11.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「It's just as Master Sergeant $$マオ$$ said. Let's enjoy the privileges of being kids today.」

28:t_015:12.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Wh-what should we do, $$マオ$$? I... don't have much cash on me today...」

28:t_015:13.en:
$$マオ$$
「Ah, a woman's gotta have guts! Sis $$マオ$$ will take care of the whole lot of you!」

28:t_015:15.en:
$$マオ$$
「You're one of the adults! You can help foot the bill!」

28:t_015:17.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「...You heard her, $$シンジ$$. Let's eat plenty!」

28:t_015:18.en:
$$シンジ$$
「...Sorry... $$綾波$$ and I have to return to $$ＮＥＲＶ$$ right away.」

28:t_015:20.en:
$$レイ#pt394$$
「$$碇$$... Our ride from $$ＮＥＲＶ$$ is almost here.」

28:t_017:0.en:
$$クルツ$$
「All right...! Another enemy team wiped out! We're on a roll!」

28:t_017:1.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Do not let your guard down, $$ウェーバー$$. A lapse in vigilance can kill you.」

28:t_017:3.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
(He keeps his spirits up even under these adverse conditions. He may have more potential than I expected...)

28:t_018:0.en:
$$アル$$
「Destruction of enemy $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$ unit confirmed.」

28:t_018:1.en:
$$宗介$$
「It is certainly a powerful machine, but it is not unbeatable.」

28:t_018:2.en:
$$マオ$$
「That's right. If we bring $c's strength together, we can do it.」

28:t_018:3.en:
$$テッサ$$
(But if that machine and other $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$ units enter full-scale mass production...)

28:t_100:0.en:
$$宗介$$
「I never expected to be lumped together with you and treated as a troublemaker.」

28:t_100:2.en:
$$宗介$$
「But I dislike being seen as a liability to the unit. We will prove our worth and change their minds.」

28:t_100:3.en:
$n
「Roger. Let's do it to protect $$千鳥$$ too!」

28:t_100:4.en:
$$スズネ$$
(As I thought, these two have it the worst because of their concern for $$千鳥$$.)

28:t_101:0.en:
$$クルツ$$
「$$宗介$$ and $n sure are moving stiffly...」

28:t_101:2.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Hey, Sis... $$宗介$$ sure has changed since he started guarding $$カナメ$$.」

28:t_101:3.en:
$$マオ$$
「Yeah. That's exactly why I want to back him up.」

28:t_101:4.en:
$$マオ$$
(Keep at it, $$宗介$$ and $n. We've got your backs.)

28:t_102:2.en:
$$厚井$$
「Earth is in danger! Let us fight too!」

28:t_102:3.en:
$$郁絵$$
「That's right! Our company's coffers matter, but peace on Earth matters even more!」

28:t_102:4.en:
$$木下$$
「Then let's go all out! All out!」

28:t_102:5.en:
$$柿小路$$
「$$木下$$ really doesn't seem to grasp the gravity of the situation...」

28:t_102:6.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Don't worry about it! Let's fight our own way!」

28:t_102:7.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Here we come, bad guys! $$竹尾ゼネラルカンパニー$$ will take down you jerks who do whatever you want while Earth's in trouble!」

28:t_102:8.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「I'll protect Mom, $$サチ子$$, $$しげる$$, $$かおる$$, and everyone else, no matter what!!」

28:t_103:1.en:
$$正太郎$$
「No, $$オックス$$. They didn't think we were useless. They left us behind because they care about us.」

28:t_103:3.en:
$$正太郎$$
「You'll understand when you're a little more grown-up, $$オックス$$. ...Anyway, we have something we need to do.」

28:t_103:5.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Let's go, $$オックス$$! We'll beat the bad guys together with $$鉄人$$!」

28:t_104:0.en:
$$シンジ$$
(Father... Fighting is breaking out all over the world. Why are you just silently watching it happen...?)

28:t_104:2.en:
$$シンジ$$
「I'm all right, $$綾波$$. I won't think about anything else right now.」

28:t_104:3.en:
$$シンジ$$
「In my heart, I'm still part of $c! So let's fight with everyone!」

28:t_105:0.en:
$$アル$$
「This unit's performance has improved since earlier. I estimate the cause lies with the operator.」

28:t_105:1.en:
$$宗介$$
「It is because I have loosened up.」

28:t_105:2.en:
$$アル$$
「Instructional message. What does 'loosened up' mean?」

28:t_105:3.en:
$$宗介$$
「If you claim to be so advanced, work it out yourself.」

28:t_105:4.en:
$$アル$$
「Is it a problem with the bilateral angle?」

28:t_105:5.en:
$$宗介$$
「You still have a long way to go.」

28:t_105:6.en:
$$アル$$
「That applies to both of us.」

28:t_105:7.en:
$$宗介$$
「Understood. Then let's cut loose like the amateurs we are!」
